NFL DFS Tight End Rankings: Week 10 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 15 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 10, 10:42 AM ET

Trey McBride is the top-projected tight end on the Week 10 DraftKings main slate at 10.4 DraftKings points for $7,100, against the Rams. T.J. Hockenson (9.5, $4,300) and George Kittle (9.0, $6,500) are next.

Elijah Higgins returns the most per dollar among tight ends projected for at least 7 points: 2.92 projected points per $1,000 at $2,500.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 10, 10:42 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Tight ends to know in Week 10

Trey McBride, ARI vs LAR ($7,100)

Trey McBride carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 10.4 DraftKings points at $7,100. That is 0.9 points clear of T.J. Hockenson. The model gives him 5.8 targets on 16.7 routes. The salary works out to 1.47 projected points per $1,000, 6th of 8 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations McBride averaged 10.5 points with a simulated floor of 0.2 and a ceiling of 31.8, and he holds 1% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Arizona is a 9.5-point underdog at home against the Rams, with an implied team total of 15.5 in a game totaled at 40.5.

T.J. Hockenson, MIN at GB ($4,300)

T.J. Hockenson projects 2nd at the position with 9.5 DraftKings points at $4,300. The model gives him 5.1 targets on 14.5 routes. The salary works out to 2.22 projected points per $1,000, 4th of 8 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Hockenson averaged 9.4 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 31.2, and he holds 6% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Minnesota is a 4.5-point underdog on the road against Green Bay, with an implied team total of 19 in a game totaled at 42.5.

Value: Elijah Higgins, ARI vs LAR ($2,500)

Elijah Higgins projects for 7.3 DraftKings points at $2,500, which works out to 2.92 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 8 tight ends the model projects for 7 or more points. The model gives him 4.4 targets on 16.7 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Higgins averaged 7.3 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 31.2, and he holds 7% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Arizona is a 9.5-point underdog at home against the Rams, with an implied team total of 15.5 in a game totaled at 40.5.
